# Tarik Ermis

> Freelance practice of Tarik Ermis, software engineer from Völklingen (Saarland, Germany) and founder of n3tz GmbH. He builds AI assistants, process automation and company-knowledge assistants for trade businesses (Handwerk) and small and medium-sized businesses (KMU). Clients approve everything that goes out. Data stays in the EU.

Contact: tarik@n3tz.ai, +49 1573 753 22 27. Working languages: German, English, Turkish. On site in Saarland and nearby, otherwise remote.

## Services

- AI assistant for calls and enquiries: picks up when the owner cannot, asks the right questions and sends a callback note
- Quote drafts from enquiries or site measurements, using the business's own line items and prices
- Receipt collection and filing, ready for the accountant at month end
- Connecting existing business software so data is not retyped; failed cases go to a person with the reason
- Company-knowledge assistant that answers from the business's own documents and names the source
- Also: websites that bring enquiries, and AI training for teams

## Case studies

- B2B car dealer (anonymised, client since 2024): purchase bots, custom software for processing each vehicle, Griffi document archive
- [MD Cleaning](https://mdcleaning-saar.de): website for a cleaning and caretaking business in Völklingen
- [Medivaro Pflege](https://medivaro-pflege.de): website and care-box application flow into the billing portal, with a human check before submission
- [HaliAvrupa](https://haliavrupa.com): Shopify shop build
- [Griffi](https://griffi.ai): own product, a digital office assistant for trade businesses
- Global DAX-listed industrial group (freelance): AI platform for more than 26,000 governance documents, in production since March 2026
